partner_context: Discovery Land Company develops and operates a portfolio of ultra-private residential club communities — many of them waterfront or boat-access — including Baker's Bay (Bahamas), Costa Palmas (Los Cabos), Barbuda Ocean Club, Moncayo (Puerto Rico) and CostaTerra (Portugal). For Discovery, the member arrival and the on-water experience are the product.

hero.headline: The arrival experience, elevated across the portfolio.
hero.sub: A silent, foiling welcome for Discovery's waterfront clubs.

why_now: Discovery competes on experience, and the weakest link at its coastal clubs is the boat ride in — loud, wet, weather-exposed and fume-filled. The N35 Shuttle turns that moment into a signature, and does it across an entire portfolio of communities at once.

network_thesis.headline: One arrival standard, every coastline.
network_thesis.body: Discovery already owns the demand, the jetties and the brand. Navier supplies a single foiling arrival experience that drops into Baker's Bay, Costa Palmas, Barbuda and beyond — the same silent, all-weather welcome at every waterfront club.
network_thesis.coverage_note: Five+ coastal/boat-access communities across the Bahamas, Mexico, the eastern Caribbean, Puerto Rico and Portugal — each an N35-native arrival corridor.

multimodal_fit: The foiling transfer is the water leg between private aviation and the club's ground fleet — a door-to-villa journey with no loud, queasy boat ride in the middle.

journeys_unlocked.today: A private flight into Marsh Harbour, then a wait for a club boat across the Sea of Abaco — the arrival the member remembers.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A silent, foiling Pioneer II waiting at the jetty: a smooth 15-minute flight across the water to the villa dock. The arrival becomes the amenity.

journeys_unlocked.today: A charter or club tender across open Abaco water, weather-dependent and far from quiet.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A foiling transfer that stays smooth in chop and arrives near-silent at the club dock.

journeys_unlocked.today: A 45–60 minute drive up the East Cape highway from the airport corridor to the marina village.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A coastal foiling arrival into the Costa Palmas marina — the Sea of Cortez as the front door, not the highway.

journeys_unlocked.today: A small-plane hop or a 90-minute ferry across open water to Barbuda's remote pink-sand coast.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A long-range hybrid foiling arrival from Antigua, smooth and private, straight to the club's beach.

journeys_unlocked.today: A tender or road shuttle to the day's water, eating into the experience.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: An on-call foiling Pioneer II for member day-trips along the East Cape, quiet and dry.

differentiation: A portfolio-wide, branded arrival experience — not a one-off boat — deployed to the same standard at every coastal community.
proof_points: Baker's Bay is a 600-acre boat-access club on Great Guana Cay — every member arrives by water.
Costa Palmas spans 1,500 acres of Baja's East Cape with its own marina village.
Navier × JIH Maldives: $100M / ~100 vessels / 3-year phasing — the resort-rollout precedent.
N35 Shuttle: 12–15 pax + luggage, all-weather enclosed cabin, shallow 1.5 m draft for cay and marina approaches.

objections.a: The N35 is a private, climate-controlled cabin with Starlink — more private and calmer than an open speedboat, with no shared terminals.

objections.q: Will it handle our remote sites?
objections.a: Shallow 1.5 m draft and level dockside boarding work with existing club jetties; no dredging or new piers.
Active foil control delivers a stable, level ride through chop that grounds conventional tenders — extending the operating window.

the_ask.partner_brings: The waterfront communities, member demand, jetties and the brand standard.
the_ask.next_step: Pick a flagship club — Baker's Bay or Costa Palmas — and scope a Phase-1 foiling arrival pilot.
